learning_outcomes.text: Possess advanced knowledge in searching, exploring, and solving problems with predicates
Understand Functional Programming, Neural Networks and Machine Learning
Be able to choose the appropriate neural network architecture to solve a classification or prediction problem
Be able to use the Python programming environment to implement the machine learning techniques
Have developed those skills of acquiring knowledge, which they need to continue further studies with a high degree of autonomy
Analytical and synthetic ability to solve problems.
Manages complex mathematical theories and techniques.
Bibliographic research, analysis, synthesis and presentation of contemporary research findings.

syllabus_topics: Logistic regression, decision tree, random forest, support vector machines
Deep learning (Multi-Layer Perceptrons, Convolutional, and Recurrent Neural Networks)
Applications on materials synthesis, characterization, and engineering
teaching_methods: Use of ICT in delivery and communication with students

assessment_methods.method: Active participation in the class (questions and quizzes)
